questions.q: In which year did Wally West first appear as Kid Flash, in The Flash #110?
questions.why: Wally West debuted in The Flash #110 in 1959, as the teenage nephew of Iris West who gains the Flash's powers.

questions.q: Which writer created Wally West with artist Carmine Infantino?
questions.why: John Broome wrote the debut, with Carmine Infantino on art; Kanigher had worked with Infantino on Barry Allen.

questions.q: How did Wally West get his powers in the original comics?
options: He was bitten by a radioactive speedster in a Central City lab
A repeat of Barry's lightning-and-chemicals accident
He found a speed ring left in the future
He was caught in a Speed Force storm in space
questions.why: While visiting Barry Allen's police lab, a repeat of the lightning and chemical accident soaked Wally and gave him the same speed.

questions.q: As Kid Flash, Wally was a founding member of which team?
questions.why: Wally was a founding member of the Teen Titans, where he became friends with Robin, Dick Grayson.

questions.q: After which 1985 event in the comics did Wally take over as the Flash?
questions.why: Barry Allen sacrificed himself during Crisis on Infinite Earths, and Wally became the new Flash in 1986.

questions.q: Which writer introduced the Speed Force as the source of the Flashes' powers?
questions.why: Mark Waid expanded Wally's abilities by creating the Speed Force, an energy source behind speedsters' powers.

questions.q: After the original Wally returned in DC Rebirth, what name was given to the biracial New 52 version of Wally?
questions.why: The 2011 reinterpreted Wally was renamed Ace West to avoid confusion once the classic Wally came back.

questions.q: Who voices Wally West as the Flash in the Cartoon Network series Justice League?
questions.why: Michael Rosenbaum voiced the Flash in Justice League, and Kid Flash in Teen Titans.

questions.q: Who plays Wally West in the live-action Arrowverse shows such as The Flash?
questions.why: Keiynan Lonsdale portrayed Wally in the Arrowverse, on The Flash and in Legends of Tomorrow.

questions.q: In The Flash #135 (1963), Kid Flash's costume was revamped to be mostly which color?
questions.why: Kid Flash went from a red suit to a mostly yellow one with red gloves, leggings and lightning emblem, to stand out more.
